question: Should this QA-only follow-up remain stacked on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/110762 and land immediately after that runtime repair, or should it be retargeted to `main` once the runtime repair lands?
rationale: The correct landing boundary depends on maintainer ownership of the paired runtime fix and cannot be inferred solely from the QA diff.

options.title: Land sequentially
options.body: Merge the runtime-reload repair first, then rebase this QA-only PR onto `main` and merge it with its focused regression coverage.

options.title: Retarget now
options.body: Move this PR directly to `main` only if maintainers confirm its QA changes do not require the companion runtime repair as their validation baseline.

recommendation.title: Land sequentially
recommendation.body: Merge the runtime-reload repair first, then rebase this QA-only PR onto `main` and merge it with its focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied feature history connects this contributor to both the preceding runtime-context refactor and the paired runtime-reload repair.
